meta.title: Guides — PreFrame
meta.description: Practical guides for filmmakers who plan to the music: cutting a song into sections, timing every shot, drawing the emotional curve, and taking it all into Premiere or DaVinci Resolve.
meta.ogTitle: PreFrame guides — plan to the music
meta.ogDescription: Practical pre-production guides for filmmakers who feel the music first.

head.title: Plan to the music.
head.lede: Short, practical guides on planning a film against its track — or against the feeling, when the track isn't here yet. Each one works on paper; each one also shows how it's done in PreFrame.

list.empty: The first guides are being written. Back soon.

article.ctaBody: Drop in the track, cut it into sections and place every shot on real seconds — or draw the curve when there's no track yet. Your first project is free and complete.
